name: urivision / VURI
summary: Run a .vuri process (image + model + aspects + decision question + result schema) into a DecisionCard — a decision with evidence, not a description — through urivision:// routes. The decision layer of the perception stack.
description: urivision (VURI, Visual URI Process Language) compiles a .vuri process into a vision-LLM call that returns a structured DecisionCard (decision, confidence, findings with evidence, next actions). This connector serves it as urivision:// URI routes so a urirun node, flow, or readiness kernel can compose the decision layer with capture (kvm), environment (vdisplay) and visual structure (vql). The compile/dry-run query runs in-process (validates a process cheaply, no model); the model-calling run is isolated. The LLM runner needs urivision[litellm] + model creds; without them the run route degrades to ok:false with a hint, never crashing the node.
useCases: Turn a screenshot + question into a DecisionCard (ok/fix/block) with evidence for a flow.
Cheaply validate a .vuri process (compile/dry-run) before spending a model call.
Provide the layer-3 vision decision when a cheap anchor is ambiguous (verify-before-act).
